name: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with Minimal Differentiation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Bone marrow or peripheral blood blasts ≥20% of nucleated cells
Blasts show minimal or no cytochemical evidence of myeloid differentiation (negative for myeloperoxidase and Sudan Black B)
Blasts express myeloid markers (CD13, CD33) but lack markers of maturation (CD11b, CD14)
Presence or absence of recurrent cytogenetic abnormalities associated with AML

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: ≥20% blasts in bone marrow or blood with minimal cytochemical myeloid differentiation and immunophenotypic confirmation of myeloid lineage
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other AML subtypes and acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

searchTerms: immature white blood cells in blood
bone marrow not producing enough blood cells
failure to make red, white cells and platelets

common.symptomName: Anemia-related pallor and dyspnea on exertion
searchTerms: pale skin and shortness of breath

common.symptomName: Thrombocytopenia causing petechiae and mucosal bleeding
searchTerms: low platelets causing small skin bleeds
petechiae and mucosal bleeding from thrombocytopenia
bleeding spots due to low platelet count
recurrent infections due to immune weakness
infections caused by low white blood cells

occasional.symptomName: Bone pain due to marrow expansion

searchTerms: losing weight and sweating at night
lung problems from blood cell buildup

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement with neurological deficits
searchTerms: nerve deficits due to CNS involvement

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing blasts with minimal cytochemical staining
Bone marrow biopsy with ≥20% blasts lacking myeloperoxidase activity
imaging: Chest X-ray may show leukostasis-related infiltrates
Ultrasound or CT for hepatosplenomegaly assessment
other: Flow cytometry confirming myeloid lineage with minimal differentiation markers

redFlags: High blast count in peripheral blood
Signs of leukostasis such as respiratory distress or neurological symptoms
references: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues, 2016
Arber DA et al. Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation: diagnostic criteria and clinical features. Blood. 2016.
Orphanet: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation (ORPHA:98832)
